idle.note: the swollen shell settles 1 px and back like a slow breath; one lower leg at a time twitches; no scaling

move.note: a fast skitter: two alternating sets of four legs lift and swing, the shell bobs 1 px with each set

bite.note: rocks back on its hind legs with the front legs raised, then lunges the head into the target at contact

kindle.note: squats 2 px with the legs splayed, then shudders 1 px as its cracks flare (the existing kindle VFX at contact) and swells 4 percent, then settles

hit.note: the shell is knocked back 2 px and the near legs splay

death.note: swells as the embers build, the legs curl in, then it bursts (the existing death-burst flash covers the moment) and is gone by 0.7
